title: Daily 5, Tue 24 Nov
sourceNote: Original questions written for this group. None of them is a CAT previous-year question.
instructions: 5 questions, 10 minutes, CAT marking: +3 right, -1 wrong multiple choice, 0 for a wrong type-in answer.
Everyone gets the same five. The ranking is by marks, then by time.
Type-in answers take a number only: no %, rupee sign or units.

questions.text: 30% of a number is 72. What is 45% of the same number?
The average of 5 numbers is 18. Each number is multiplied by 3, and then 4 is added to each result. What is the new average?
A sum earns ₹1,800 as simple interest in 3 years at 12% per annum. What is the sum, in rupees?
A, B and C can each finish a job alone in 10, 12 and 15 days. How many days do they take working together?
One root of x² + kx + 12 = 0 is 3. What is the other root?
